blocks.text: Indelible art: the punk tattoo artist preserving an ancient Thai tradition – in pictures

When Aod-Sarawut Waewngam learned tattooing at the age of 18, his goal was to tattoo himself. Drawn to punk culture as a teen, he first saw the art as an act of rebellion. But as his skill grew, he developed an interest in traditional Thai tattoos. Now, he is one of the few to have mastered the ancient art of Lanna leg tattoos, which cover the wearer from the knees to the waist, and is working to preserve the traditional art form while adapting the practice to modern times
